Scripts.OnClick: if BuildCreatorUtil.GetHeldSpell() then return BuildCreatorUtil.PlaceHeldSpellAtLevel(self.level) end BuildCreatorUtil.SetPickMode(BuildCreatorUtil.PickingMode.Spells, self.level) Collections:GoToTab(Collections.Tabs.CharacterAdvancement) BuildCreatorUtil.RefreshFinishPickingPopup()

Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(self.tooltipTitle, 1, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:AddLine(self.tooltipText, nil, nil, nil, true) GameTooltip:Show()

Scripts.OnVerticalScroll:
self.scrollbar:SetValue(offset) local min, max min, max = self.scrollbar:GetMinMaxValues()
if offset == 0 then self.scrollUpButton:Disable() else self.scrollUpButton:Enable() end
if (self.scrollbar:GetValue() - max) == 0 then self.scrollDownButton:Disable() else self.scrollDownButton:Enable() end
self:GetParent():GetParent():OnVerticalScroll(offset)
